original_test_intent: Exercise GPU compute, near-capacity memory, distributed HPL and PCIe transfer paths as an integrated sequence and verify workload correctness, rocHPL performance and PCIe bandwidth without platform errors.
original_method: Run immutable approved GEMM, Oblex, rocHPL and TransferBench artifacts with the source parameters in an approved sequence/concurrency model, under continuous thermal/power/ECC/MCE/PCIe/driver monitoring and independent watchdogs, then evaluate each workload and cross-workload recovery.
manual_activity: GPU/HPC owner pins all artifacts and topology, approves sequence/concurrency and baselines, supervises OOB recovery and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Eight-GPU/BDF/NUMA/MPI P2Q4 topology and workload isolation plan
Approved sequential or concurrent schedule and settle intervals
GEMM error/performance, Oblex miscompare, rocHPL residual/GFLOPS and PCIe pair-size baselines
safety_requirements: Preflight topology, free memory, cooling, power and OOB
Reserve control-plane memory despite Oblex 98% target
Use independent per-phase and total watchdogs
Monitor temperature/power/ECC/MCE/AER/driver/OOM and stop on first unsafe condition
No automatic rerun; recover and health-check between phases as approved
agent_execution_scope: Verify all approved inputs and exact parameters
Execute approved phases once with complete telemetry
Parse every workload-specific result and transition
Abort/recover/report without changing baselines or deciding DUT result
engineer_actions: Approve artifacts, schedule, topology and all quantitative limits
Disposition workload/health/transition anomalies and decide outcome

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the four literal approved workloads in the authorized integration schedule with phase markers, independent watchdogs and synchronized result/health capture.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a phase/concurrency manifest with exact commands, resource reservations and start/stop markers; evaluate each workload's native correctness/performance plus transition and cumulative health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes integration ownership and quantitative acceptance auditable rather than treating the run as one generic stress result.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No single workload or shortened smoke test substitutes for the four-component integration case.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sequential execution measures cumulative compatibility; concurrent execution creates a different contention test and requires explicit approval.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must decide whether the four source steps are sequential or overlapping and provide per-workload baselines plus allowable cross-workload contention effects.
expected_evidence: Approved artifact/config hashes, versions and topology/schedule manifest
Exact commands/exits/timestamps and phase or concurrency timeline
GEMM checks/performance and Oblex iteration/miscompare results
rocHPL residual/GFLOPS plus MPI mapping and complete TransferBench pair/size bandwidth
Between-phase/final health, cleanup/recovery, dispositions and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The four workloads are clearly specified; execution ordering/concurrency is underdefined but can be supplied without changing source coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Artifacts, schedule, baselines and safety approvals are fulfillable project prerequisites.

review_improvement: Restores all four literal workloads and makes combined resource ownership, phase transitions and independent acceptance explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: Oblex at 98% memory can starve MPI/runtime control paths, while rocHPL and GEMM saturate compute/power and TransferBench depends on stable PCIe topology. Running them concurrently is materially different from sequential accumulation, so schedule is part of the testcase contract. Each native correctness oracle must remain visible; a healthy final OS cannot prove no intermediate miscompare, residual or link degradation occurred.
